scope: Killable owned ScreenRecord process and EN/RU recovery. Private synthetic GStreamer, files, Unix sockets, test worker re-exec and Xvfb/session D-Bus/Tauri/MockBackend only. No real PipeWire source, production daemon, HID, host session or install.
implementation: GUI re-execs its own executable in internal worker mode before Tauri/single-instance startup. The parent retains portal session and private staging; child alone executes GStreamer native/plugin operations.

Private typed length-prefixed Unix socket protocol with9MiB allocation bound,2MiB JPEG bound,15s startup/finish and5s command deadlines;25ms transfer interruption checks. Ordinary application errors allow snapshot retry; broken transport/protocol/deadline latches failure and reaps child.

Selected PipeWire FD and private control socket inherit as4/3; unrelated>=5 FDs are CLOEXEC via checked close_range. Missing syscall fails startup. Inherited FD checks precede from_raw_fd ownership. Parent-death SIGKILL plus parent identity check.

Cancel/Drop/GUI shutdown kill and reap child before TempDir/portal release. Final MP4 moves inside parent staging and requires successful child exit and regular-file/length/frame validation before Ready. Existing source/review/HTTP leases remain.

Common worker timeout/exit/protocol/source-close/startup failures have EN/RU UI messages; Clear allows a new selection without automatic save/restart. Recording harness now explicitly selects RU in private fixture settings instead of assuming the product default.

focused_recording.note: Focused run preceded one constructor-use cleanup; final all-features workspace covers final code without that dead-code warning.

browser.scope: Recording UI/client including EN/RU worker failure -> Clear -> fresh source selection; no media_confirm

checks.static_rust_review: Verifier identified unrelated non-CLOEXEC FD inheritance; fixed with close_range and sentinel regression, then re-reviewed with no further concrete findings. Parent executed Cargo chain.

coverage: Real synthetic child setup/snapshot/crop/pause/resume -> decodable finalized MP4 -> child reaped while parent file lease remains -> file/staging removed on release.
Nonresponsive worker startup cancellation, command timeout, cancellation and portal-close during finish. Child PID absent after reap; incomplete file not admitted; new recording possible.
Actual recording-owner Cancel and Shutdown interrupt blocked child status request, join/reap and remove staging within2s fixture deadline; Cancel permits subsequent capture.

Child exit73 and oversized response header fail without Ready output. Selected readable FD contents arrive correctly; parent copy remains usable. Sentinel non-CLOEXEC fd>=200 is absent in child and remains open in parent.
Native normal source preview/crop/keyboard-region/record/pause/resume/review/re-edit/reprepare/explicit Save/gallery/Close flows, including one-shot admission/preparation errors.

Native production180s limit automatically pauses at4320 frames/180000ms, Cancel retains stable limit and focus, Resume rejected, full review duration180s and final-frame seek, explicit Save, gallery membership and normal joined Close.
initial_verification_failures: Initial Clippy reported unneeded unit expression; removed. One intermediate test-only dead-code warning was fixed by passing cancellation into setup fixture.

Initial browser run failed two new fixture assertions (wrong English button selector and incorrect expectation that Clear closes the recorder) and one existing detached-Start assertion during concurrent frontend build. Corrected fixture actions/selectors, serialized frontend operations; final40 tests passed without a product change to that existing flow.

First native run stopped before recording because the historical RU-only harness assumed Russian on a fresh English-default installation. Harness now explicitly persists RU only in private fixture; same native product binary then passed normal and full-limit flows.

informational_resource_samples.scope: synthetic320x240 recording; informational only, no performance threshold or hardware claim
synthetic320x240 recording; informational only, no performance threshold or hardware claim

limits: No real ScreenCast portal/PipeWire FD/serial capture, compositor timestamp/resend/resizing or particular native-plugin deadlock qualification.
SIGKILL cannot force uninterruptible kernel I/O; local wait/staging filesystem operations may still block. Actual permissions/kernel/resource/performance/platform matrix remains.
Requires Linux close_range CLOEXEC support (kernel5.11+); unavailable syscall fails recorder startup without stopping main GUI/LCD runtime.
Private native RU harness and browser EN/RU are not actual screen-reader speech, Wayland/fractional scaling or full desktop-session acceptance.

Process isolation owns lifetime/cancellation; it is not an untrusted-plugin sandbox. Extra effects/additional languages and other device families remain deferred; Mini remains Plasma widget/GNOME Shell extension.
